operations.text: 0.3.9 moves four texts to the stage file every session that applies them reads. /pnp:mission reads the core and ticket.md, never work.md or plan.md, yet it closes tickets and plans. The archive of a finished plan and the roadmap writes move from plan.md § Durable development history to the end of ticket.md § Durable development history. The ticket boundary - about 400k tokens, a heavy ticket, what a ticket's session reads, the session brief - moves from plan.md § Plan readiness review to a new ticket.md § The ticket boundary; plan.md keeps 'a readiness cycle starts in a fresh session'. Out-of-scope failures found during work and the status / release docs policy move from work.md to the core ORCHESTRATOR.md, under the same headings, because R1 work and planning sessions do not read ticket.md. The texts move word for word; only their cross-references changed. If a local rule of yours in a project additions block, your overrides document or your memory points at one of these texts by its old stage file, re-aim the pointer; a local rule that modifies one of them belongs in the additions block of its new stage file - on your operator's word, never by this update, which moves nothing of yours. This update re-renders ORCHESTRATOR.md, work.md, ticket.md, plan.md and the managed CLAUDE.md region; every additions block is carried.
